setup_initialization_order.action: Return if UClass+d4 bit11 is set; also return if UClass+78 is null.
Clear own NetFunctions+120 and NetProperties+130; recurse into SuperStruct+48.
Inherit parent ClassReps+110 (stride16), and auxiliary array+100 (stride16). Root clears ClassReps.
Walk own FProperty chain+70 with excludeSuper/includeDeprecated/noInterfaces. Require FFieldClass bit15, flags+48 bit5, Object owner variant, owner exactly this class. Append NetProperties.
Walk own UObject Children+58 with same iterator flags; require Function class, FUNC_Net bit6, no SuperFunction+48. Append NetFunctions.
Sort own NetProperties by signed offset+54 then case-insensitive ASCII name. For each property write RepIndex=low16(ClassReps count); append ArrayDim stride16 {property, static_array_index} records.
Shrink arrays, sort NetFunctions by case-insensitive ASCII name, set class bit0x800.

If current global1e340a04 nonzero call conditional post-setup validation. It may create CDO (class vslot388) and calls CDO vslot1b8 to collect lifetime entries. Virtual callback bodies/current global value are not qualified.

class_net_cache_initialization_order.action: Construct class weak key from object index+24 and native registry serial delegate. Lookup manager+8 weak-key map (hash low XOR high, equality qualified). Non-null value returns immediately without setup or checksum revalidation.
On miss, call descriptor setup; allocate0xd0 cache, construct weak key+10 and empty field/maps, then publish manager entry before parent recursion.
Reset parent/start/checksum; recursively acquire superclass cache; parent+8 points to it, own_start=parent.own_start+parent.own_count, checksum=parent checksum.

Append one stride32 cache field per NetProperty in setup-sorted order. Property tag0, index=own_start+own_count, field checksum=property_checksum(seed0, recurse=false), reserved/incompatible byte0. Does not read or copy FProperty.RepIndex.

Append one stride32 field per sorted NetFunction. Function tag1; index increments same cache field sequence. Checksum folds lowercased name then flags+c0 formatted %u; invalid Function-class cast yields checksum0.
Finalize/shrink fields. Build descriptor-to-field map+30 and checksum-to-field map+80. Duplicate checksum causes optional log, then insertion continues; not an identity/compatibility rejection.

Sort property-only temporary list using same comparator, fold recursive property checksums with inherited class seed into cache+18, then return. Function checksums are separate field entries and not part of this aggregate class checksum loop.

index_domains.property_rep_index: u16 property+50: inherited ClassReps record count before this property; static ArrayDim expands records; native writes low16, no overflow guard proved here.
index_domains.class_net_cache_index: u32 field record+10: inherited cache total + one per property or function; ArrayDim does not expand this cache vector.
index_domains.rep_layout_handle: u16 RepLayout command record+14 generated separately by recursive/leaf command builder; ClassReps index and ClassNetCache index cannot be substituted.

checksum_rules.property_field: CRC of ASCII-lowercased FName::ToString property name (None for null), then ASCII-lowercased GetCPPType virtual slot60 string, then ArrayDim formatted unsigned decimal %u; seed0, recurse=false.
checksum_rules.function_field: CRC of ASCII-lowercased Function FName::ToString, then full u32 FunctionFlags+c0 formatted %u; seed0.
checksum_rules.aggregate_class: Seed parent aggregate checksum or0, fold recursive property checksums in sorted own property order; excludes function field checksums.
checksum_rules.recursive_array: FFieldClass flags+10 bit21 follows inner property+90 and repeats base checksum fold with current seed.
checksum_rules.recursive_struct: FFieldClass flags+10 bit20 folds lowercased UScriptStruct name+1c, enumerates property fields+70 including super/deprecated, excluding flags+48 bit31, sorts then recursively folds.
checksum_rules.crc: Reflected CRC32 polynomial0xedb88320; complement seed, process each nonzero UTF16 code unit as four bytes low8/high8/0/0, complement result. Terminator excluded.
checksum_rules.ascii_lower: A-Z become a-z in scalar and SIMD paths; other UTF16 words retained. This is not Unicode case folding.
checksum_rules.ordering: Signed OffsetInternal+54 ascending, tie by UTF16 lexicographic name comparison with ASCII-only lowercase table when both differing code units<128. Non-ASCII compares raw words. Function comparator uses name alone.
checksum_rules.closure_status: Native main bodies, sorting/CRC/lowercase helpers and updated immutable tables qualified. Complete checksum output equivalence is NOT qualified: current FName wrapper tables and dynamic GetCPPType outputs/vtable bindings remain missing.

deterministic_reuse_requirements: For current native-cache reuse: same current process/driver/cache manager; decoded class object identity, object index+24 and current registry serial; allocated/live weak-key map entry with exact weak-key equality and non-null cache pointer.

Capture current cache weak key+10, parent+8, own_start+0, own_count+28, checksum+18, fields+20 (stride32), descriptor-map+30 and checksum-map+80, including sparse occupancy/hash/next-index evidence. Revalidate class identities and parent chain in a bounded consistent snapshot.
Map field records to current property/function descriptors and names, not old pointer values. CRC equality alone cannot prove identity; duplicate-checksum path logs then continues.
Require completed/stable cache observation: insertion occurs before parent recursion and population, so non-null cache pointer alone can expose an in-progress build to a racing reader.

A native cache hit does not re-check class flags, RepIndex, class checksum, or metadata mutations. Historical cache records/weak serials from another process/build do not prove a current hit or compatible schema.
independent_reconstruction_requirements: Capture current complete superclass chain, class identity/path, flags+d4 (bit11 setup state), class+78 guard, original own field chains+70/+58 and their ordering, property/function ownership and type-test identities/flags.

For properties: actual FName token and qualified exact display string, descriptor type/FFieldClass flags, Net/deprecated/skip flags used by each iterator, ArrayDim, signed OffsetInternal, Object owner variant, existing RepIndex and current ClassReps/NetProperties arrays for verification.

For functions: current Function class membership, FName/display string, full uint32 FunctionFlags+c0, SuperFunction+48; sorted NetFunctions array and parent functions. The own-property snapshot has no UFunctions.

For checksums: actual current GetCPPType slot60 target/output for every property; exact FName::ToString numeric suffix/name formatting; recursive array Inner+90, struct+90/name/field chain/super chain and all nested type/skip flags. Qualify callees before independent emulation.

Preserve original chain order or prove comparator keys unique. These native sorts are not certified stable; equal offset and case-insensitive name keys need original input order and the exact algorithm to prove resulting order.

To reproduce RepLayout handles or lifetime conditions, additionally capture current layout/parent/command arrays, CDO class/instance and lifetime-property callback output/flags/conditions, dynamic type-specific serializers and native build context. Those inputs exceed ClassNetCache/RepIndex construction.

This research does not emulate setup/cache/checksum or invoke virtual methods. Reconstruction remains blocked on missing current metadata and unqualified dynamic dependencies, not on the unchanged storage offsets alone.
